userStories.title: Fix TYPE_CHECKING import path in stages/__init__.py
userStories.notes: Tier: T1 (quick fix). File: src/stages/__init__.py, line 18. The TYPE_CHECKING block imports 'from .state import PipelineState' but there is no state.py inside src/stages/. The correct import pattern is already used elsewhere in the file at the runtime import on line ~209.

userStories.title: Add state snapshot before stage execution for rollback capability
userStories.notes: Tier: T3 (architecture enhancement). File: src/pipeline.py, lines 290-400 (stage execution loop in run()). Currently if a stage fails partway through, PipelineState may be left in an inconsistent state (partially modified by the failed stage). The only recovery is --fresh. Add a shallow copy of state before each stage runs, and restore it on failure. This is not full transactional rollback, but prevents the most common corruption scenarios.
acceptanceCriteria: Before each stage.run() call in PipelineOrchestrator.run(), create a shallow copy of critical state fields (matches, alternatives, downloaded_segments, output_files)
On stage failure (result.success == False), restore the state to the pre-stage snapshot
Log when state rollback occurs with the stage name and fields restored
Add a test that verifies state is restored after a stage failure (mock a failing stage, check state is clean)
Existing pipeline execution is not affected when stages succeed (no performance regression from snapshot)

userStories.title: Move config validation before checkpoint loading in pipeline orchestrator
userStories.notes: Tier: T2 (architecture improvement). File: src/pipeline.py, lines 274-279 in run(). Currently _validate_config() runs at the start of run() but after PipelineOrchestrator.__init__() which sets up the checkpoint manager and potentially loads checkpoint data. Config validation should happen in __init__() or as a separate validate() method called before run(), so that invalid configs fail fast before any expensive checkpoint I/O.

userStories.title: Consolidate entity stage registration into optional stage group
userStories.notes: Tier: T2 (architecture improvement). Files: src/stages/entity_images.py:27-28, src/stages/entity_videos.py:27-28, src/pipeline.py:645-687. EntityImagesStage and EntityVideosStage are registered via @register_stage but never added to any pipeline factory function and are not in STAGE_ORDER. They exist as orphan stages. Either: (a) add them to create_default_pipeline as optional stages between ANALYZE and VIDEO_SEARCH, or (b) remove @register_stage from them and document they are manually-added optional stages. Option (b) is preferred to keep the 7-stage pipeline clean.

userStories.title: Add pipeline stage contract test to verify all stages handle minimal state
userStories.notes: Tier: T3 (test infrastructure). Files: src/stages/*.py (all 7 stage files), src/state.py (PipelineState). The user interview identified that the stages module had zero test coverage for the kind of bug found (stale state references). A contract test that instantiates each registered stage and calls run() with a minimal PipelineState would catch AttributeError and similar crashes from stale references. This is a parametrized test over all stages in STAGE_ORDER.
